setting.help: After you download a show or episode, check for newly aired episodes when Kodi opens or returns to the screen. Follow your chosen quality and save to Google Drive. No continuous episode searches; future and undated episodes wait.
Scan Kodi Downloads or a folder available to Kodi. Missing movies and shows are uploaded to Google Drive; phone copies are removed only after the Drive files are verified.

Scan on startup and after uploads. Prepare one seekable MP4 in the same Drive file, keeping the selected source resolution and compatible HDR. Follow progress in Notifications. Movie data stays on Drive; processing uses bounded phone RAM.
Every video in Google Drive › Kodi Downloads: ready for Kodi and AirPlay, preparing, downloading, waiting or kept as it is, with what can be done about each.

Measurement build (DEC-039): upscales one prepared 720p or 1080p video to 4K UHD with Apple's AI super resolution and writes time, speed, heat, battery and size to kodi.log. Nothing is uploaded or changed on Google Drive.

AllDebrid to Google Drive copies go through this iPhone: every gigabyte is downloaded and uploaded again. On cellular that uses twice its size in data and is usually slow. When on, copies wait for Wi-Fi and carry on from where they stopped.

A download that only needs its container rearranged for Kodi and AirPlay is made ready while it is copied to Google Drive, instead of being read back from Drive afterwards. If that does not work for a file, it is copied as it is and prepared later as before.

Keep work running while using other apps or with the screen locked. Plays silent audio while work is queued. Calls or iOS resource limits can interrupt it; work resumes when allowed. Powering off or force-quitting stops phone-side work.

Elementum's torrent traffic runs only while a VPN is verified, and stops when that stops. Works with any VPN app: it needs a tunnel and a public address that differs from this iPhone's home address, which it learns while no VPN is on (kept only as a salted hash). It is a check made every few seconds, not a kill switch: keep the VPN's own kill switch on. Normal Kodi playback and AirPlay are not touched.

control.heading: Words from the VPN network's name, e.g. its provider

setting.help: Optional. When set, the public address must also belong to a network whose name contains one of these words (comma separated). Needed if the VPN was already on the first time this ran.
Two services must agree on the address. They see the address the phone shows to the internet, with or without the VPN.
